toolingOnly.problem: A boundary observer repeatedly looked up Unity runtime state per simulation unit and produced artificial backlog.
toolingOnly.resolution: Excluded that attempt; clean owned game restart; observer uses the actual CitySimulator instance from the patched unit boundary and caches the target meal. No primary performance window includes this observer.

toolingOnly.problem: Independent diagnostic clients initially shared a single request.json mailbox; unsupported spaces in request identifiers were also ignored by one observer.
toolingOnly.resolution: Foreground observer calls now use an OS file mutex and identifiers restricted to the accepted ASCII grammar. Only the affected owned diagnostic commands were interrupted for tooling faults; no game was killed.

toolingOnly.problem: Bridge speed6 changes the native calendar multiplier, yielding travel-clock rate2.0. Reloading a held context at normal rate can safely invalidate its schedule.
toolingOnly.resolution: Those accelerated-clock decision attempts are excluded. The gating control/candidate held saves and reloads use normal clock throughout, with persisted rates approximately one third.

toolingOnly.problem: A refusal snapshot exposes an error string as expected result data.
toolingOnly.resolution: Client accepts that documented snapshot shape; ordinary tool error objects still fail.

toolingOnly.problem: Time-machine completion and clock overlays can briefly reject a following time command.
toolingOnly.resolution: Wait for target/skip completion and use the bridge UI escape/collapse seams before retry; no pointer or focus proof claimed.

toolingOnly.problem: Managed process working-set values are zero on the game runtime.
toolingOnly.resolution: Use read-only external Windows memory sampling every50ms; retain managed heap/GC observations separately.

provenance: Reused/adapted previous locked A3 rig bridge/frame/native-save tooling and the locked-session feasibility workflow. Test-only sources, raw data, backups and native saves remain private in the stage. Portable public verifier checks the sanitized artifacts without game DLLs.
